title: The Little Robot & The Lost Star
artStyle: Cute, cinematic, high-quality 3D-looking cartoon animation with rich depth, volumetric lighting, and particle effects

scenes.title: The Magical Forest
scenes.visualSummary: Deep nighttime magical forest with layered trees, volumetric mist, and glowing floating fireflies. The small green robot walks smoothly through the clearing.
scenes.characterAnimation: Smooth walk cycle, subtle body bobbing, eye blinking, small antenna sway.
scenes.cameraNotes: Slow cinematic tracking shot following the robot rightward with parallax tree layers.
scenes.audioNotes: Gentle nocturnal ambient breeze, soft cricket chimes, metallic footstep pitter-patters.

scenes.title: The Falling Star
scenes.visualSummary: A brilliant golden-white celestial star falls diagonally across the canopy, leaving a shimmering particle tail. It impacts gently on the forest moss.
scenes.characterAnimation: Robot pauses, turns head upward with startled wide eyes, pupils dilating in surprise.
scenes.cameraNotes: Camera whip-tracks the falling trajectory and pans down to the landing site.
scenes.audioNotes: High ethereal falling whistle/whoosh, followed by a soft crystalline chime impact.

scenes.title: Saving the Star
scenes.visualSummary: The robot kneels beside the dimming, weakly pulsating star. He scoops it up gently with both hands and looks up at the vast sky.
scenes.characterAnimation: Bends knees and hips, scoops star with both arms, cradles it close to glowing chest plate, concerned eye angle and soft blink.
scenes.cameraNotes: Push-in medium close-up focusing on robot's expressive eyes and the warm golden glow illuminating his face.
scenes.audioNotes: Gentle mystical hum, delicate glass chime heartbeat as star pulses faintly.

scenes.title: The Mountain Journey
scenes.visualSummary: Steep rocky mountain incline at night. Fierce wind gusts sweep blowing leaves and cold particles across the cliffside.
scenes.characterAnimation: Determined climbing strides, body leaning forward against the gale. A sudden gust causes a wobble; robot securely hugs the star with both arms to shield it.
scenes.cameraNotes: Wide dynamic tracking shot showing towering mountain scale, subtle handheld camera shake during wind gusts.
scenes.audioNotes: Howling mountain winds, gust sweeps, strained mechanical foot steps on stone.

scenes.title: Returning the Star
scenes.visualSummary: High mountain summit above the cloud line. The night sky is crystal clear. Robot steps to the edge, lifts the star high, and casts it into the heavens.
scenes.characterAnimation: Anticipation squat, smooth extension as arms thrust skyward releasing the star; head tracks star soaring into the upper atmosphere.
scenes.cameraNotes: Camera cranes upward, tilting vertically to follow the star soaring through the sky leaving a golden trail.
scenes.audioNotes: Wind subsides; deep bass crescendo followed by a radiant rising chord and launch whoosh.

scenes.title: Magical Ending
scenes.visualSummary: The star locks into the center of the firmament, detonating a wave of thousands of sparkling constellations and colorful aurora ribbons. Robot watches in awe, smiling warmly.
scenes.characterAnimation: Robot stands relaxed, smiling with eyes curved happily, chest light glowing emerald-cyan in sync with the sky, head gently tilting.
scenes.cameraNotes: Grand cinematic pull-back reveal, floating upward to show robot silhouetted against the swirling cosmic galaxy.
scenes.finalText: Sometimes, even the smallest hands can bring back the biggest light.
scenes.audioNotes: Lush orchestral music swell, shimmering stardust chimes, peaceful resolving harmony holding through the fade.
